blocks.html:
This method confirms the return receival. It sends a request to the
[Confirm Return Receival](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#returns\_postreturnsidreceiveconfirm)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the return to confirm the receival of.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the receival confirmation.

children.name: no_notification
children.description:
Whether to send a notification to the customer
for return updates.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the return.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order that the return belongs to.

children.name: exchange_id
children.description:
The ID of the exchange that the return belongs to,
if available.

children.name: location_id
children.description: The ID of the stock location that the items are returned to.

children.name: claim_id
children.description:
The ID of the claim that the return belongs to,
if available.

children.name: order_version
children.description: The order's version once the return is applied.

children.name: display_id
children.description: The display ID of the return.

children.name: no_notification
children.description:
Whether to send the customers notifications about
return updates.

children.name: refund_amount
children.description: The amount that is to be refunded to the customer.

children.name: received_at
children.description: The date when the return was received.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date when the return was created.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the user that created the return.

children.name: canceled_at
children.description: The date when the return was canceled.
